metas.name: Architecture - Alternating Brick Pattern
metas.note: Walls decorated in a brick pattern, typically consisting of three different colours, are found mainly in the west of the country.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Georgia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - Brick Linings
metas.note: Buildings with exposed red brick accents, which may frame windows, form grids or run horizontally through walls, are found primarily in Kakheti.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Georgia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - Flat Roof Tiles
metas.note: Flat clay roof tiles with rounded bottom edges are found primarily in this part of Kvemo Kartli.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Georgia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - Grass-Covered Roofs
metas.note: Low, long buildings with grass-covered roofs can sometimes be found in southeastern Samtskhe-Javakheti.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Georgia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - Greenhouses
metas.note: Greenhouses are found in various pockets from west to east, with the greatest concentration in the southeast of Kvemo Kartli.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Georgia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - Metal Light Fences
metas.note: Lightweight decorative metal fences are very common in coastal regions of Georgia and, to a lesser extent, in Imereti.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Georgia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - Metal Picket Fences
metas.note: Metal picket fences, ranging in colour from white to brown, are very common around Zugdidi, near the border with Abkhazia. However, they may rarely be seen elsewhere in the west.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Georgia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - Metal Picket Fences Framed
metas.note: Metal picket fences with a top and bottom rail are most common in these parts of Imereti and Guria.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Georgia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - Metal Ridge Ornaments
metas.note: Metal ornamentation on roof ridges is commonly found in the southeast of the country. The style of this ornamentation can vary and may not run along the whole ridge of the roof.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Georgia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - Net Like Wall Pattern
metas.note: Walls with net-like mortar patterns can sometimes be seen near Zugdidi.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Georgia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - Open Air Pavilions
metas.note: Open-air pavilions decorated with ornamental patterns can be seen adjacent to houses in this part of Kvemo Kartli.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Georgia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - Ornamental Balconies
metas.note: Intricate, decorative metal trim running along the edges of roofs, awnings and porches can be found primarily in Imereti. You can also see decorative metal awnings above external doors in this area. These awnings will often have a triangular gable shape and sometimes come in pairs.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Georgia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - Ornamental Gates & Fences
metas.note:
Gates and fences with specific types of ornaments can often be seen in and around Imereti.

These include:

  • Horizontal scrollwork inserts
  • Panels with filigree brackets in the corners, usually with an embossed design in the middle
  • Ornamental trim.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Georgia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - Pebble Walls
metas.note: Walls made from small rounded rocks are most commonly found in Kakheti.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Georgia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - Pinkish-Purple Bricks
metas.note: Houses built from pinkish-purple bricks, made from tuff volcanic rock, can be found in a southern belt extending to the west coast and are particularly common in Kvemo Kartli and Samtskhe-Javakheti.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Georgia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - Rectangular Panels With White Outlines
metas.note: Although not as common as the buildings with corrugated sheet walls, buildings with walls made from rectangular panels with white outlines can be found in a similar area in the west of the country.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Georgia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - Round Hole Fences
metas.note: This style of metal fence with round holes is usually found in the parts of the coastal regions shown on the map.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Georgia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - Rounded Wall Tops
metas.note: Walls with rough, rounded coping on top can be seen in Kvemo Kartli and Kakheti.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Georgia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - Sheet Metal Walls
metas.note: Residential buildings with walls covered fully or partially with corrugated metal sheets can sometimes be found in the west of the country. They are especially common in the coastal areas south of the Rioni River.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Georgia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - Stilt Barns
metas.note: Small barns on strikingly high stilts are found particularly in Adjara and, more rarely, in other regions in the west of the country.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Georgia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - Svan Towers
metas.note: These distinctive stone towers are unique to the region of Svaneti in northwestern Georgia.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Georgia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - Triangular Dormers
metas.note:
Houses with triangular dormers, usually with windows made from brightly coloured tinted glass, can be seen southeast of Tbilisi and around the town of Mughanlo in Kakheti.

Tinted glass in general is also more common in this area than elsewhere in the country.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Georgia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - Triangular Gables
metas.note: Small triangular gables above a hipped roof are often seen in the areas of southern Georgia marked on the map.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Georgia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - Unholy Metal Gates
metas.note: Gates with scrollwork mounted on a metal surface (so without holes in the scrollwork) are a good clue for the southeast of the country.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Georgia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - Wavy Ridge Ornaments
metas.note: Metal roof ridge ornaments with a sinusoidal wave shape are only found in and around Mughanlo in Kakheti.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Georgia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - White Bricks
metas.note: Houses with walls made entirely or partially of small white bricks are found primarily in Imereti.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Georgia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - Wooden Picket Fences
metas.note: Picket fences made from wooden planks are most common in hilly and mountainous parts of western Georgia.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Georgia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - Wooden Pole Fences
metas.note: Fences made from irregular wooden poles, often connected with wires or sticks, are common in the coastal regions and Imereti.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Georgia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Landscape - Alazani Valley
metas.note: The Alazani Valley is a flat, wide, east-west valley located on the far eastern side of the country. The Greater Caucasus Mountains rise directly above the northern side of this valley, with snow-capped mountains often visible. A huge proportion of the valley is occupied by vineyards, which are relatively rare in other parts of the country.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Georgia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Landscape - Chiatura Valley and Plateaus
metas.note:
Chiatura is a famous spa town situated in a valley in Imereti. The valley itself is notable for its many exposed rock formations, while the plateaus above are recognisable for their patches of uncharacteristically barren land for western Georgia. This can create baity rounds that look eastern. However, you will generally see more cattle, flimsy fences and distant forests as well as architecture metas associated with the west in this area.

Random piles of jagged rocks by the roadside are also common on the plateaus. Note the city itself is one of the rare instances where you can find commieblocks in a hilly setting.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Georgia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Landscape - Dedoplistskaro Hills
metas.note: These distinctive hills with exposed grey rock can sometimes be seen near the town of Dedoplistskaro.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Georgia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Landscape - Flat Coastal Plain
metas.note: A very flat coastal plain reaches from the central portion of the coast up to the city of Kutaisi. This is the largest completely flat part of the country, and can be distinguished from flat areas in the east by the warm, humid climate. There are no tall mountains visible. Other common features in this area include cattle, flimsy wood fences, poplar trees and grassy dirt roads.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Georgia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Landscape - Flat Dry Periurban Landscape
metas.note: The area shown on the map, in the southeast of the country, has a relatively flat, dry landscape. This area is surrounded on multiple sides by low, dry ridges, which can sometimes be seen in the distance, and a taller dry ridge can be seen to the south in areas nearer the Armenian and Azeri borders. Business parks and industrial buildings can commonly be seen in this area.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Georgia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Landscape - Gori Ridge
metas.note: A dry ridge with clearly visible tilted rock strata can be seen to the north of the valley between Gori and Kaspi in Shida Kartli.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Georgia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Landscape - Industrial Landscape
metas.note: The Rustavi-Gardabani corridor in eastern Kvemo Kartli is the most heavily industrialised part of Georgia, with a chief characteristic being large industrial chimneys, often visible from a distance.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Georgia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Landscape - Liakhvi Plain
metas.note:
Roughly in the middle of the country, south of South Ossetia and north of Gori, there is a large dead-flat area around the banks of the Liakhvi River.

This area is identifiable by being the only flat region encased by low mountains to the north and south (unlike the Alazani valley with its much taller mountains to the north). Fruit trees are common in this area but not fully exclusive to it.

Note there are some similar-looking flat areas further east around the towns of Saguramo or Sakdrioni. However these are much smaller and the mountains will always appear much closer.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Georgia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Landscape - Meskheti Range
metas.note: The Meskheti mountain range is located in the southwest of the country. Due to its high altitude, it creates a treeless but still humid island within the rainy and otherwise densely forested part of the country. There is only one road that completely bisects it: the SH14 crossing over the Zekari Pass.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Georgia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Landscape - Shiraki Plain
metas.note: The Shiraki Plain is an extremely flat agricultural plateau, with dark soil and an otherwise barren look.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Georgia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Landscape - Shulaveri Rock
metas.note: A distinctive rock formation overlooks the town of Shulaveri in Kvemo Kartli and can often be seen from the valley to its east.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Georgia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Landscape - Southeast Semi-Desert
metas.note: The southeast of Georgia along the Azeri border is the driest part of the country. This semi-desert environment generally has undulating hills and no vegetation besides grass.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Georgia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Landscape - Tall Forested Mountains
metas.note:
Svaneti is a cultural-geographic region in the northwest of Georgia that is fully within the Caucasus Mountains.

Tall, snow-capped mountains, mostly (but not always) organised in east-west ridges, are almost always visible. However, the region can be more reliably told apart from the eastern Caucasus mountains by its much more forested environment.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Georgia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Landscape - Temperate Rainforest
metas.note: Due to warm ocean currents from the Black Sea, the Georgian coast is both very warm and very humid, resulting in a temperate rainforest climate, particularly in the mountains near Batumi where rainfall is highest. Here you will find very dense vegetation, with lots of ferns, vines, rhododendrons, butterbur, moss, palms and large-leaved deciduous trees such as alder.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Georgia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Landscape - Treeless Mountain Valley
metas.note: Kazbegi is the other high mountain area in the Georgian Caucasus that has coverage. The iconic Georgian Military Road, connecting the country to Russia, cuts through the mountains here. As mentioned above, it can be differentiated from Svaneti by the absence of forests along most of its length, although it is possible to find forests along the southern part of the road. However, even here, the trees are typically shorter and less dense than those in Svaneti.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Georgia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Landscape - Tsalka Steppe
metas.note: Similar to the volcanic plateau of Samtskhe-Javakheti, this area near Tsalka has a hilly, steppe-like landscape with large clusters of coniferous trees visible in the distance. It can be distinguished by the absence of pinkish gravel road shoulders and by the comparative lack of agriculture.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Georgia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Landscape - Volcanic Plateaus
metas.note: This part of Samtskhe-Javakheti consists of a barren plateau surrounded by volcanic hills. Isolated clusters of coniferous trees are sometimes visible in the distance. The road shoulders here are made from pinkish gravel and agricultural fields with dark soil can often be seen nearby.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Georgia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Vegetation - Beech Forests
metas.note: There is a unique beech forest in Tbilisi National Park, known as the Sabaduri Forest (clearly labelled on Google Maps), which looks unlike anything else in Georgia. Note that the trees are covered in heavy moss which can make them look like birch trees at first glance.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Georgia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Vegetation - Eucalyptus
metas.note: Eucalyptus trees are exclusively found in the far west coastal areas of the country.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Georgia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Vegetation - Ferns
metas.note: Ferns are a reliable indicator for the humid western half of the country, with particularly large quantities being a good indicator for the temperate rainforests in Adjara and near the Abkhaz border.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Georgia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Vegetation - Japanese Red Cedar
metas.note: Japanese Red Cedar (Cryptomeria japonica) is a common tree in the humid far west of the country, being especially common in coastal areas.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Georgia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Vegetation - Turkish Pine Forests
metas.note: Forests of Turkish pines are exclusively found in the hills in the immediate vicinity of Tbilisi.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Georgia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord
